items.title: Mavericks' Caleb Martin: Not guaranteed minutes
items.author: CBS Sports
items.body_excerpt: Mavericks' Caleb Martin: Not guaranteed minutes CBS Sports

items.title: Sixers dumped Caleb Martin’s four-year deal (along with a 2030 second-round pick) and got 103 games of Quentin Grimes and 55 minutes of Johni Broome out of it. Still very good business, but did not turn out to be a heist to the degree it seemed a year ago.

items.body_excerpt: Dallas is the home of the 6ft 9 wings with big wingspans now. Their center depth is also very good, lively, Gafford, cisse. They are lacking in PG depth currently and SG depth. [Source]( https://www.espn.co.uk/nba/team/depth/\_/name/dal/dallas-mavericks )
